reason: Runner v4 technical validation rejected every candidate in these trajectories only because the CN2-D rule accepted a direct cloudtrail.lookup_events() call but not the equivalent cloudtrail.get_paginator('lookup_events'), which issues the same CloudTrail LookupEvents API. None of these candidates was executed. Runner v5 fixes the rule; offline re-validation with v5 passes all 20 affected candidates with no other error and leaves the other 51 archived verdicts unchanged.
decision: Trajectories regenerated from scratch by runner v5 on the next --run; originals preserved here unmodified.
